resources.string: Oh My Haze checks AQI estimates for one place you choose. It saves that place and does not track your movements. Readings use nearby regional information and may differ from conditions where you are.
Air quality is checked approximately every hour. Android battery settings may delay or occasionally prevent checks and alerts.
Your saved coordinates are sent directly to Open-Meteo for each check. Open-Meteo may log coordinates and your network IP. Oh My Haze has no account or backend.
